title: Serve the built portal from the HTTP server

costar.context: Action execute does not post. The remaining portal step is the engine serving the Svelte app. The unpacker refuses a VERSION file whose major is above 1, so a 2.0.4 zip is not the way to serve this UI.
costar.objective: Serve the built Svelte portal from the HTTP server when ui/build contains 200.html, without a VERSION file and without restarting the running server.
costar.style: One plan, then the file resolver.
costar.response: A page path resolves to 200.html. An asset path resolves to its file. API, /admin, and /account stay on the existing handlers.

concerns: A VERSION file of 2.0.4 makes unsupported_bundle_version refuse the zip.
The running process still has the old binary. This change is in the next process.
Falling back every extensionless path to 200.html would hide /admin, /account, and the API.
context: adapter-static writes ui/build/200.html. The HTTP server matches the first path segment, then serves an unpacked zip at /admin and /account. shippin.tech_PORTAL_DIR overrides the default ui/build directory.
current_state: The running server on port 8080 returns the Svelte page at /portal and the hashed script. /healthz/live stays problem+json. /admin stays the unpacked app.
target_design: resolve_portal maps a safe relative path to a file, and maps an extensionless page to 200.html. GET requests use that file when the directory contains 200.html. API prefixes, /admin, and /account do not.
changes: Add the path resolver and the GET response.
Call it for login and for paths that are not already an API or zip prefix.
Build ui/build so the directory exists for the next process.
boundaries: Do not add a VERSION file.
Do not restart the running server.
Do not post a set, a live delivery, or a live action.

verification.name: portal-files
verification.proves: A page resolves to 200.html, an asset resolves to its file, a parent path is rejected, and an API path is not served.

verification.name: ui-build
verification.proves: The Svelte app builds to ui/build/200.html.
